## Changelog
[li] Time Relic Chaos! - April 2, 2024   []
[li] Fixed an issue where Crowberry Cookie cannot receive the Blast effect after acquiring a Blast item once starting their dash.   []
[li] Lights, Camera, Action! - February 29, 2024   []
[li] Applied Blast Mode speed to the broom riding phase of Crowberry Cookie's skill when triggered by Dragon's Tail, Magmabird, Light Bros, Picky   ["Dragon's Tail", 'Magmabird', 'Light Bros']
[li] Holiday Training Academy Exam - December 6, 2023   []
[li] Obtained a Costume, Embracer of the Night.   ['Embracer of the Night']
[li] Holiday Training Academy Exam - November 28, 2023   []
[li] Changed the flying speed during broomstick flight to no longer use the fixed speed feature.   []
[li] Changed the broomstick flight to apply the Giant Mode and Blast Mode during flight.   []
[li] Fixed an issue where collision detection was shifted to the right in the crow transformation state.   []
[li] Energy reduced by 20.   []
[li] Cooldown time reduced by 3 sec.   []
[li] Increased points per Stolen Jewel.   []
[li] Increased points for Jewel Shard Jellies.   []
[li] Increased points for Crowfeather Jellies.   []
[li] Increased points for Golden Crowfeather Jellies.   []
[li] The Treasure of Legends - May 27, 2022   []
[li] Obtained a Costume, Feathered Flamestealer.   ['Feathered Flamestealer']
[li] Adjusted tower spacings to make it easier to obtain the jewels.   []
[li] Significantly reduced the cooldown time to Blast quicker after obtaining all the jewels.   []
[li] Increased the duration of skill activation to allow successfully collecting Jewel and Crowfeather Jellies after returning from an interrupte   []
[li] Changed for Crowfeather Jellies to be created steadily throughout while the Cookie Blasts on the broomstick.   []
[li] Increased the number of Crowfeather Jellies created.   []
[li] Decreased point value for Crowfeather Jellies.   []

[li] Crowberry Cookie's Embracer of the Night was accidentally added to the Costume Shop gallery before its proper release. It has since been rem   ['Embracer of the Night']
